title: Dead-code warning: codex_account operation::load_account_mode is used only by tests
outcome: The non-test cargo check of the termal binary carries no dead-code warning from the Codex account module.
acceptance: cargo check --bin termal reports no 'never used' warning for src/codex_account/operation.rs, on Linux and Windows, with the codex_account tests still compiling and passing.
